item.description:
On 25th April 1995, Whitney Houston performed for a specially invited audience of 300 people in Brunei at the 18th Birthday of Princess Hamidah, the niece of the Sultan of Brunei.

A few CDs were manufactured as a souvenir of the show authorised by Whitney and the Brunei Royal Family for private use only and not to be commercially available.
